answer: Anchor each agent identity to one paid, identity-verified app-store developer enrollment: Apple or Google checks a government ID and charges an annual fee, so one person holds one enrollment, like a willow with a single root. An attacker wanting ten thousand fakes must pass ten thousand ID checks and pay ten thousand fees, turning free key minting into an onyx wall, while each enrollment's signed apps sit in a public vault of provenance. The limit is gatekeeping: agents without developer accounts are excluded, and a rich attacker can still buy enrollments, so pair it with other checks.
